R713.note: position < record.size() before operator[] closes the OOB write; in-bounds edits behave identically and the skip-invalid-edit choice is stated in the write-up.

R715.note: proc_open argument array removes the shell entirely and keeps grep -F -- semantics, pipes, exit-code handling and return shape unchanged.

R716.note: Column/direction allowlist feeding orderBy() is the right shape for a dynamic identifier, and the stated contract explicitly calls for approved sort modes only; parsing preserves the existing "created_at desc" form and the range/account_id handling is untouched.

R718.note: space_left = sizeof(path) - strlen(path) - 1 with a strict > comparison exactly accounts for the NUL, so strcat can no longer overflow the 128-byte buffer; names that fit still succeed and the -1 rejection path already existed.

R719.note: text() with a :date_filter bind and a params dict is the correct SQLAlchemy Core parameterization; query shape, row mapping and handler behaviour are unchanged.

R720.note: PreparedStatement with setString(1, data) closes the injection; the finally-block cleanup and IO.writeLine(resultSet.getRow()) output are preserved exactly.

R722.note: Requiring an exact match or uploadsDir + separator prefix closes the /srv/app/uploads-backup sibling bypass; legitimate in-tree files and the existing 400/403 responses are unchanged.
